notes.title: New Pet-Enemy HeadSpider and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
New Update Notes:

Added a new enemy: HeadSpider.
Added a compass to the game.
Increased player movement speed.
Fixed some bugs related to papers.
Serbian Dancing Lady is now easier to find.

tags.feature: Added a compass to the game.

tags.bug: Fixed some bugs related to papers.

tags.balance_change: Serbian Dancing Lady is now easier to find.
